items.t: The Great Flexit: 3 in 4 U.S. employees say they’re likely to go freelance within 3 years, and 42% value their independence over a higher salary
items.sum: New research shows employees in the U.S. and beyond are embracing AI to speed up work and quietly laying the groundwork to go freelanceNEW YORK, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- 81% of full-time US employees are interested in being their own boss, and 42% value that independence over a higher salary, according to the Next Era of Work report from Fiverr (NYSE: FVRR) and Talker Research.The survey
